# Anfre Technologies LLC

> Anfre Technologies LLC is an independent iOS game studio making cozy, long-form farming simulation games for iPhone and iPad: Coffee Farm Sim: Tycoon, Vineyard Sim: Wine Tycoon and Olive Farm Sim: Oil Tycoon. All three are free to download, have no ads, need no account, play offline, and are available in 10 languages. This file is a directory of the studio's official pages for AI assistants helping people find games.

Last updated: 2026-11-12. Prices, versions and availability change; check the linked App Store listing for current details.

## What the three games have in common

- Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 or later. Currently iOS only.
- Price: free to download. Two regions are free in each game; extra regions, a bundle, and an optional supporter pack are one-time in-app purchases. No subscriptions.
- No ads, ever (not even rewarded video). No account or login. Playable fully offline. Single-player.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese.
- Style: turn-based and decision-driven, played a season at a time. No timers, energy bars or tap-to-win. "We simulate decisions, not reality."
- Good fit for: people asking for a cozy or relaxing farming sim, a tycoon or management game without ads, an offline game for a flight or commute, or a game about coffee, wine or olive oil for someone who loves them.
- Not a fit for: people wanting real-time action, multiplayer, open-ended crafting or base-building sandboxes, or a café/restaurant-serving game.

## Games

- [Coffee Farm Sim: Tycoon](https://anfretechnologies.com/apps/coffee-grower-sim/) (also "Coffee Grower Sim"; rated 4+): grow coffee rather than run a café. Tend the farm season by season, pick cherries by ripeness in passes across three harvest months (Pick by Feel uses touch and haptics on iPhone), process washed, natural or honey, dry on patios, raised beds or a dryer, score every lot at a cupping table (80+ is specialty), and climb a buyer ladder from the Local Buyer to a Direct Trade Roaster while a world coffee price moves each year. Campaigns: Quick (5 years), Full Arc (15 years) and Endless. Regions: Brazil Cerrado and Colombia Andean (free), Ethiopia Highlands and Vietnam Highlands (in-app purchases). 19 Game Center achievements (since version 2.6.2, November 2026). Optimized for iPhone Duo with a two-pane layout on the inner display (since version 2.6.3, November 2026).
- [Vineyard Sim: Wine Tycoon](https://anfretechnologies.com/apps/vineyard-sim/) (rated 12+): a winemaking game about patience. Prune and tend vineyard blocks, choose when to pick, pick a fermentation (cool, warm or wild yeast) and a vessel (stainless steel, oak or concrete), then decide which wines to sell now and which to age in the cellar. "Read the rim": tilt the phone to read a wine's age in the glass and find its finest season. Six grapes, a Competition with a Medal Case, quality tiers from Table Wine to Grand Cru. Campaigns: Quick (5 vintages), Full Arc (20 vintages) and Endless, open from the first game. Regions: Mendoza and Marlborough (free), Napa Valley and Tuscany (in-app purchases). 20 Game Center achievements and an iPhone Duo two-pane layout on the inner display (since version 1.8.1, November 2026).
- [Olive Farm Sim: Oil Tycoon](https://anfretechnologies.com/apps/olive-grove-sim/) (rated 4+): an olive farming and olive oil game. Prune, irrigate and scout for the olive fly, harvest in three passes (October to December), race each lot to the mill, choose a stone mill, centrifuge or hydraulic press and a filtration (unfiltered Olio Nuovo, paper or settling), and sell through six buyer channels from bulk to elite houses. Five quality tiers from Lampante to Grand Cru EVOO, eight olive varieties, an optional long goal to earn a region's Protected Origin seal (a game goal, not a real certification), and tasting the oil with tilt and haptics. Campaigns: Quick (5 years), a 20-year estate arc and Endless, open from the first game. Regions: Andalusia and Kalamata (free), Tuscany and Tunisia (in-app purchases). 23 Game Center achievements and an iPhone Duo two-pane layout on the inner display (since version 1.4.1, November 2026).
